Select molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, target_type, tax_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Join target_dictionary on assays.tid, assays on activities.assay_id, molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno, compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno. Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1075094', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
